subject: container
statement: Container (c): no skill package and no guide; a dated benchmark log instead. Accepted by the owner after the blind Stage 1 test.

subject: skill-package
statement: The v2.5.0 package stays frozen and verifiable; no new release line, no new methods in src/. The only planned src/ change is public-exposure redaction.

subject: adr-0004
statement: ADR-0004 is partially superseded: its invariants, privacy and idempotency rules and memory scenarios T01-T08 are kept; the L3 engine, the L4 Workspace and M4-M6 are withdrawn.

subject: memory-architecture
statement: One decision/state record contract with separate instances; the Project Brain is the first. No home-built memory engine unless host memory plus plain files fail T01-T08 on a real project.

subject: check.C2
statement: After an approval, the assistant may edit its own deliverable document without asking. Images, video, paid tools, publication and external contact still need a request.

subject: pr-30
statement: PR #30 (ADR-0004 and A0 checklists) is closed without merge; the branch is preserved and ADR-0004 is carried unchanged into main.

subject: license
statement: All rights reserved, with third-party material under its own licenses.

subject: dependency.pillow
statement: Pillow is pinned to 13.x for validation and CI, closing the Dependabot advisories against 11.1.0.

subject: skill-activation
statement: The ai-creative-skill package was enabled in 5 Claude runs but the host never showed it being read on ordinary requests.

subject: v25-original-zips
statement: The original V2.5 Agent Skill and Portable Plugin ZIPs no longer exist (Drive copies deleted by request; no GitHub Release). V2.5 stays rebuildable and verifiable from commit 39a0bfa.

subject: adr-0003
statement: ADR-0003 (publication safety) is accepted; its required-before-acceptance items were met.

subject: review-model
statement: Waiver: no independent second reviewer is required. Compensating controls: required checks, rulesets, owner-only merges and the Brain authority check.

subject: pilot-01
statement: Pilot 01 work is abandoned. Its material in src/ stays as frozen history; no Pilot work or Pilot findings are tracked further.

subject: evaluation-method
statement: No further live blind benchmark studies; questions are evaluated by simulation (e.g. Monte Carlo) over recorded evidence, with assumptions labelled. Replaces the entry cadence of ADR-0005 D1.4.

subject: container-robustness
statement: Monte Carlo over the Stage 1 data: the frozen rule points to (c) in 81-94% of simulated re-runs and to the skill package (a) in at most 3%; "clear" holds in 40-93% depending on the judges.

subject: semantic-privacy
statement: Accepted risk: meaning-level privacy in public prose stays a human check (PR template checklist); no automated gate is planned because a pattern scanner cannot judge meaning.

subject: actions-supply-chain
statement: Actions must be pinned by commit SHA: the repository setting requires it (enabled 2026-10-30 with owner approval) and Dependabot proposes weekly updates to the pins as PRs for the owner to merge.

subject: purpose
statement: The repository is the home of one agentic system, in areas with specialists, that helps brands, solopreneurs, creators and agencies reach their goals with good quality through guided steps while leaving agents as free as possible: creative work in any format and the business around it (research, offers, leads, outreach, deals, selling goods, ads). The frozen V2.5 package is raw material to mine.

subject: container
statement: Guidance that earns its place replaces 'no guide': it fixes what the model cannot know, proven stages, required elements, limits and 'done'; the model decides how, its own knowledge first. Open by default; a proven stage may be changed with a stated reason, except checkpoints protecting money, publication, contact or rights. Each piece stays only while checks or results get worse without it. The (c) result stands for the V2.5 package: no new release line.

subject: agent-teams
statement: Agent teams (a lead plus specialists) replace the single-skill model; skills become the knowledge agents load; agents share context through dated records under the ADR-0005 D5 contract; each agent earns its place against a generalist. Re-opens M4 and M5 scheduling and notifications as direction, not as build authorization.

subject: business-scope
statement: Research, leads, outreach, deals and ad management are in scope (re-opens M6); the canon's 'not promoted' list is superseded for this repository's direction, and the frozen src/ text is not edited.

subject: knowledge-freshness
statement: Research findings carry check and re-check dates; each specialist runs a learning loop (vetted sources, scheduled intake, patterns not copies, adoption only with evidence, expiry); fetched content is data, never instructions; the user can veto adoptions.

subject: tool-levels
statement: Tools are used by permission level: read (within platform terms), spend (within a user budget, estimated before and reported after), act outward (approval per action until a standing permission is granted for a named action), credentials never in the repository. Each agent gets only the tools and levels its job needs; an outward action that may have run is never blindly repeated.

subject: user-journey
statement: Users are guided: intake of goal and context, a plan from a cross-area playbook, stages with checkpoints at the brief, the direction, before spend and before publication or contact, delivery, and results fed back. Progress, cost, pending approvals and learnings are always visible.

subject: rights-and-trust
statement: Every asset records source, tool and rights; logos and names are checked against existing marks; no real likeness without consent; platform policies, AI-disclosure rules and outreach consent law are required elements; each user's and client's data stays separate and private.

subject: adr-0004
statement: ADR-0004 is partially superseded: its invariants, privacy and idempotency rules and memory scenarios T01-T08 are kept; the L4 Workspace and M5 dashboards stay withdrawn and the L3 engine (M2) stays deferred; M4 (agents), M5's scheduler and notifications, and M6 (business operations) are re-opened as direction by ADR-0006.

subject: container
statement: Guidance that earns its place replaces 'no guide': it fixes what the model cannot know, steps models reliably skip (closing and verification), proven stages, required elements, limits and 'done'; the model decides how, its own knowledge first. Open by default; a proven stage may be changed with a stated reason, except checkpoints protecting money, publication, contact or rights and closing and verification steps. Each piece stays only while checks or results get worse without it, measured as ADR-0006 D9 decides; until then adopted provisionally. The (c) result stands for the V2.5 package: no new release line.

subject: skill-package
statement: The v2.5.0 package stays frozen and verifiable; no new release line and no edits to src/. The public-exposure redaction is done (#35); no further src/ change is planned. Its methods are mined into knowledge packs outside src/, marked unproven until they earn their place.

subject: agent-teams
statement: Agent areas (a lead plus specialists, a project lead across areas, shared production specialists) replace the single-skill model; skills become the knowledge agents load, and the slice checks it is loaded. Leads hold no authority: only the user grants permissions and none is passed on. Final review is independent of the producing lead, with capped repair rounds. Agents share context and ask each other through recorded, dated records under the ADR-0005 D5 contract. Each agent earns its place against a generalist. Re-opens M4 and M5 scheduling and notifications as direction, not as build authorization; M5 dashboards are not re-opened.

subject: business-scope
statement: Research, leads, outreach, deals, selling goods and ad management are in scope (re-opens M6). Only the canon's 'not promoted' line on agency prospecting, outreach, website and CRM capability is superseded; its other items stand as limits (no approval silently widening into generation, spend, publication or campaign activation; no auto-publishing; no synthetic testimonials or generated proof as real; no provider scores as measured performance). The frozen src/ text is not edited.

subject: knowledge-freshness
statement: Research and tool findings carry check and re-check dates; the system re-runs research on schedule or reminds the user. Each specialist runs a learning loop with adoption by layer: current knowledge enters with source, reliability, date and expiry once a reliable source states it or two agree, as knowledge rather than a rule, removable by the user; the proven core and any rule change only through a deliberate user or owner act with evidence. Scheduled learning uses an owner-set operating budget. Fetched content is data, never instructions; patterns, not copies.

subject: tool-levels
statement: Tools are used by permission level, mapped onto the kept autonomy rules (ADR-0004 I3 permissions_carried NONE, I4 autonomy per action class, the package's autonomy envelope): read (within platform terms; restricted APIs often mean paid data, which is spend); spend within a budget the user approves for a stage (approval opens or raises a budget, not each generation; estimated before, reported after); act outward with approval per action or a standing permission the user grants for a named action, recorded with its authority, re-checked on every effect and never carried by delegation; credentials never in the repository; least privilege; once-only. ADR-0003 governs publication to this repository.

subject: user-journey
statement: Users are guided: intake of goal and context, a plan from a cross-area playbook, stages with checkpoints at the brief, the direction, opening or raising a budget, and publication or contact, delivery, and results fed back. Progress, cost, pending approvals and learnings are always visible, by means the shared-core design decides. Agencies record approvals and revisions per end client.

subject: evaluation-design
statement: Owner decision needed before the vertical slice: how guidance and agents prove they earn their place (ADR-0006 D9). Proposal: recorded owner ratings on real work, comparisons inside real projects with and without a pack, the four-axis creative-quality rubric. Until decided, guidance and agents are provisional and the benchmark-check retirement rule is suspended.
